notes.title: Game release! Thanks everyone!
notes.notes:
So the time came for the full release of the game and it happened. We want to say a big thank you to everyone, for buying our game and supporting us and Ukraine. We, as promised, will send humanitarian aid to Ukraine and all this is thanks to YOU! The game does not cost that much, but everyone who bought it helped Ukrainians in need of humanitarian assistance. I also want to remind you that our team is Ukrainian and we see it for everyone, we live here and it’s hard for all of us, but together we are strong and together we can survive and live.  Thank you all! Glory to Ukraine!


Also, what's new in the game:
Changed the location a bit, namely:

 New buildings
 New vehicles
 Javelins and Bayraktar appeared on the map
 Minor bug fixed
